text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Yahhh!
All right!
We made it to the big thirty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～いっ！
やった～！
これで30回やっつけたね！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
We beat so, so many ghosts already,
but I guess there's still some left!
Don't worry, I can still keep going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たくさん、
た～っくさんやっつけたけど、
幽霊さんたちはまだいるみたいだね～
ミミ、
まだまだがんばるよ～！
